sources.snippet: Sarashina2.2-TTS is a Japanese-centric text-to-speech system built on a large language model, developed by SB Intuitions. It supports Japanese and English, delivering high pronunciation accuracy, naturalness, and stability across diverse speaking styles, with zero-shot voice generation support.
